Hymn 310: A Key Was Turned in Latter Days
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: C Major

This is hymn number 310 titled "A Key Was Turned in Latter Days" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Janice Kapp Perry and the lyrics were written by Jan Underwood Pinborough.
